page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz.

This instance configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, there are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance type.

The ecs.r9i.4xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring significant memory capacity without the added cost of excessive CPU cores.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include relational and non-relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data processing tasks that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.
